categories.main_business_segments: Doctor Glasses Chain Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the optical retail industry, focusing on retailing eyeglasses, including optical glasses, sunglasses, progressive lenses, digital protection lenses, and smart glasses. The company operates multiple brands targeting different market segments such as high-end customization, professional optometry, franchise operations, new retail, fashion fast consumption, and retro culture themes. It also provides comprehensive vision health services including eye exams, myopia control, and visual rehabilitation through partnerships with hospitals and community health centers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced optical technologies and collaborates with global manufacturers like Carl Zeiss, Essilor, and LVMH for high-quality lenses and frames. It integrates AI and IoT technologies in developing smart glasses, including AI smart audio and AR glasses. The company employs centralized procurement and inventory management systems, digital supply chain management, and ERP systems to optimize operations and product offerings. It also emphasizes professional optometry services supported by certified personnel and advanced fitting equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include individuals with vision correction needs across all age groups, with a focus on children and adolescents for myopia control, and the elderly for progressive lenses and vision health. The company serves consumers in urban core commercial areas, shopping centers, supermarkets, and medical institutions. It also targets online consumers via e-commerce platforms and local life service platforms. The company’s market includes both direct consumers and franchisees in the optical retail sector.
categories.geographic_coverage: Doctor Glasses operates extensively across China, with a presence in 25 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities including Guangdong, Jiangxi, Chongqing, Jiangsu, Yunnan, Sichuan, Hainan, Zhejiang, Anhui, Guangxi, Beijing, Shanghai, Hubei, Shandong, Hunan, Shaanxi, Liaoning, Fujian, Ningxia, Tianjin, Guizhou, Gansu, Shanxi, Tibet, and Heilongjiang. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong. The company focuses on first- and second-tier cities while expanding into lower-tier markets through franchising.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the downstream segment of the optical industry supply chain, focusing on retail sales and vision health services. It acts as a retailer and service provider, sourcing products from upstream manufacturers and suppliers. It also manages a centralized procurement system and supply chain logistics, including warehousing and distribution to its extensive network of stores and e-commerce channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes digital transformation, intelligent retail, and integration of traditional and smart eyewear products. It invests in R&D for smart glasses in partnership with technology firms, aiming to lead in AI-enabled optical products. The company focuses on expanding its franchise model, enhancing professional optometry services, and increasing penetration of functional lenses. It also prioritizes upgrading ERP and CRM systems to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of optical products including glasses, lenses, sunglasses, and contact lenses via direct retail stores, online platforms, and franchise stores. The company also earns from vision health services such as eye exams and myopia control. Additional income comes from investment returns and government subsidies. The sales channels include self-operated stores, online e-commerce platforms, and franchised outlets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Doctor Glasses is a leading listed optical retail chain in China, recognized for its strong brand portfolio, extensive sales network, and professional service capabilities. The industry is highly fragmented with intense competition from small chains, individual stores, and emerging players including ophthalmic hospitals and midstream lens manufacturers entering retail. The company maintains a leading market share through brand differentiation, supply chain strength, and digital innovation, positioning itself as a top-tier, cross-regional operator.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.2 billion, a 2.29% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 103.6 million, down 19.08%. It operates 557 stores nationwide, including 510 direct-operated and 47 franchise stores. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.25 billion, with a net asset value of RMB 760.6 million. Despite profit decline, the company shows steady revenue growth and continues to invest in digital and smart eyewear development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Doctor Glasses emphasizes a differentiated brand matrix catering to diverse consumer needs, combining fashion, functionality, and professional vision care. It offers high-quality, customized optical products and advanced vision health solutions, including myopia management and progressive lenses. The integration of smart glasses and AI technology enhances customer experience and product innovation. The company’s strong supply chain, professional optometry services, and digital marketing capabilities create a unique value proposition focused on clear vision and trendy eyewear.
